text:
Predicates:
Podcast(x) ::: x is a podcast.
Novel(x) ::: x is a novel.
BornIn(x, y) ::: x is born in y.
AmericanCity(x) ::: x is an American city.
American(x) ::: x is American.
Book(x) ::: x is a book.
WrittenBy(x, y) ::: x is written by y.
NovelWriter(x) ::: x is a novel writer.
Premises:
¬Podcast(familySecrets) ∧ Novel(familySecrets) ::: A podcast is not a novel.
∀x ∀y (BornIn(x, y) ∧ AmericanCity(y) → American(x)) ::: If a person is born in American City, the person is American.
∀x ∀y (Book(x) ∧ Novel(x) ∧ WrittenBy(x, y) → NovelWriter(y)) ::: If a book is novel and it is written by a person, then the person is a novel writer.
American(daniShapiro) ::: Dani Shapiro is an American writer.
WrittenBy(familyHistory, daniShapiro) ::: Family History is written by Dani Shapiro.
Book(familyHistory) ∧ Novel(familyHistory) ::: Family History is a novel written in 2003.
Podcast(familySecrets) ::: Dani Shapiro created a podcast called Family Secrets.
AmericanCity(boston) ::: Boston is an American city.
Conclusion:
NovelWriter(daniShapiro) ::: Dani Shapiro is a novel writer.
